notes: Towns are planned now: houses stand on proper lots along the streets with their doors to the road and a footpath to the street, instead of being scattered around the plaza
Every town has a ring lane and a cross avenue, street lamps at a steady rhythm, the Relay Center on the lot nearest the plaza and the Trial Hall next to its Warden
Trees, rocks and crystals no longer grow on building plots; spare plots become small pocket parks
Lumen Harbor's houses keep their plaster-and-brick look, now lined up on the streets with flowerbeds by the doors
